snippet.title: Enigma Heart | Steam Next Fest Demo | Available Now!
snippet.description:
🎮️ store.steampowered.com/app/2986980/Enigma_Heart/  ▶ The ENIGMA HEART Steam Next Fest demo is available now on Steam!

In a high adventure tale of old, guide the young heroine Zalia on a quest against evil forces threatening her world! Inspired by early action RPG classics, you'll travel the world, bask in the comforting glow of a tavern fire, battle wicked monsters, fight to free your world from the clutches of evil, and even find love in the arms a beautiful tavern keeper in... ENIGMA HEART!

🦋 BLUESKY: https://bsky.app/profile/hadrosaurus.net
🐘 MASTODON: https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@HadroSoft
🌐 WEBSITE: https://www.hadrosaurus.net/enigma-heart/

Designed, programmed, written, and directed by Clarissa Toney
Art direction and pixel art by Szabó Emily
Music by Martijn Frazer
Illustrations by Cial and Pepperly

#SteamNextFest #Indiegame #NextFest #EnigmaHeart
